decisions.statement: A charge is transferred or recategorized only or already done.
The outcome is decided before anything is written.
A charge already carrying the Audible category is done rather than moved again.
A charge is found by the word Audible in its merchant or its statement line or its note.
A row this scheme itself wrote is passed over.
A credit and an uncategorized charge and a charge noted as reimbursed are recategorized only.
History is carried from the first of January two thousand and twenty-five onward and no earlier.
The decider is recorded as this migration rather than as a rule.
A run may be narrowed to named rows.

definition: the Audible charges already standing, carried onto the budget scheme that replaced them
